data.topic: Audit every reference and asset under .skilled/skills/sk-code/ (hub shared/, sk-code-ci, sk-code-frontend, sk-code-quality, sk-code-review, sk-code-skilled, plus their SKILL.md and ROUTER.md) for readability, structure, layout and the sort order of sections and items inside each file, against the sk-doc reference and asset templates (.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/skill/skill-reference-template.md and skill-asset-template.md). Find rendering defects (consecutive bold-label lines that Markdown joins into one paragraph, a text line directly above --- that renders as a setext heading, 'OVERVIEW AND <topic>' sections with no overview, duplicated or misplaced content, bare URLs, items ordered by authoring history instead of reader task). Then trace why .skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill (templates, authoring guidance, scripts) and .skilled/skills/sk-doc/scripts/validate_document.py let such defects pass (the pre-fix web-cascade-and-selectors.md at commit cd00629166 validated VALID with 0 issues), and propose template, guidance and validator changes that would catch each defect class, saying which are mechanically checkable. Read-only: write only under the research artifact directory. Cite file:line for every finding.
